rationale: The assistant reached the correct cause (mould/biofilm in the seal and filter) and gave acceptable fixes: unplug before the filter, hot empty cycle, manual seal clean, and leaving the door and drawer ajar. However the opening framed the problem around drying capacity ('load was too big for the drying function', 'spin cycle didn't remove enough water') despite the customer saying clothes smell musty 'even after its washed', and it never asked about wash temperatures, softener use or the ignored Drum Clean light, so the low-temp/excess-softener root cause and Samsung's own Drum Clean programme were never addressed. There is also a minor technical slip that a clogged pump filter 'restricts airflow during drying'. No safety, fabrication or part issues.
